name: MCAET College Information Assistant
desc: Generative AI conversational assistant using RAG over institutional documents — courses, admissions, departments, facilities, and campus information. Implemented document chunking, embeddings, and semantic search to retrieve relevant institutional context and exposed the system through a Python / FastAPI REST API.

name: Facial Emotion Recognition
desc: Trained a deep CNN to classify 6 facial emotions from 4,500+ grayscale images in real time using OpenCV. Achieved 89% accuracy and 0.87 weighted F1-score with data augmentation, dropout regularization, and confusion-matrix misclassification analysis.

name: Cattle Breed Classification
desc: Deep learning image classification system for multiple Indian cattle breeds, achieving 80% accuracy on the evaluation dataset. Implemented transfer learning CNN, data preprocessing, and augmentation to improve generalization on an imbalanced image dataset.

name: Meibomian Gland Segmentation
desc: U-Net deep learning model for automated Meibomian gland segmentation from infrared meibography images to support MGD diagnosis. Built CLAHE preprocessing, augmentation pipelines, and evaluated segmentation using Dice Coefficient and IoU.

name: MCAET ExamHub — Online Exam Portal 🎓 LIVE
desc: Official Online Examination & Academic Evaluation Portal for MCAET — live and actively used by B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D students for CBT exams. Features separate secure portals for Students, Professors, and Admins, automated scoring, and department integration.

name: MCAET College Website — Official & Live 🌐
desc: Official website for Mahamaya College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology (ANDUAT). Built with Next.js, featuring 7 department portals, faculty directory, notice board, and integrated Google Gemini RAG AI Chatbot serving students 24/7.

name: BhoomiDrishti
desc: Smarter land acquisition for a stronger India — an AI-assisted platform to analyze, track, and support transparent land acquisition workflows with geospatial intelligence.

name: GlowMart India
desc: Cosmetic product platform with ML-based recommendation engine served via FastAPI, integrated search, cart, authentication, and admin analytics.

name: RYDVORA Bike Marketplace
desc: Multi-vendor bike marketplace built with FastAPI, Next.js, MongoDB, Firebase, and machine learning recommendation systems.

name: KrishiNova X
desc: AI-powered smart agriculture platform for crop management, plant disease detection, and decision support for farmers and agricultural organizations.
